_about: Sound registry. sfx = Mirelo Text to Audio (duration seconds), music = ElevenLabs Music v2.5 instrumental. Game code calls Sfx.play("<name>"); loops are marked loop=true.

sfx.name: sword_swing
sfx.prompt: a short steel sword swinging fast through the air, sharp whoosh, no impact

sfx.name: sword_hit
sfx.prompt: a sword slicing into thick monster hide, sharp wet slash and a heavy thud, impact at the very start, short

sfx.name: glance
sfx.prompt: a single bright metallic clang of a bronze sword striking hard stone hide, high ringing ping and a short scrape, sparks, dry and close, impact at the very start, no low rumble

sfx.name: roll
sfx.prompt: a warrior doing a quick combat roll on packed dirt, cloth rustle and body tumble, short

sfx.name: step_dirt
sfx.prompt: a single leather sandal footstep on dry packed dirt, close, short

sfx.name: step_stone
sfx.prompt: a single leather sandal footstep on polished marble, crisp heel click and soft scuff, starts immediately, close, no rumble

sfx.name: shield_up
sfx.prompt: a bronze shield being raised quickly, leather strap creak and a light metal rattle

sfx.name: block
sfx.prompt: a huge wooden club smashing against a bronze shield, deep metallic gong-like clang and thud

sfx.name: reflect
sfx.prompt: a magical beam of light reflecting off a polished bronze shield, bright shimmering ring that rises in pitch

sfx.name: hurt
sfx.prompt: one short deep male grunt of pain as a warrior is struck, close microphone, loud and clear, starts immediately, no breathing after

sfx.name: death
sfx.prompt: a strong man's final pained groan and his body collapsing on the ground with armor rattle

sfx.name: petrify
sfx.prompt: a body turning into stone, fast crackling of rock spreading, gritty stone crunch, ending in a hard click

sfx.name: cyclops_roar
sfx.prompt: an enormous giant roaring, very deep monstrous bellow echoing across a stone quarry

sfx.name: cyclops_step
sfx.prompt: one single enormous footstep, a heavy deep boom on packed earth at the very start, a little gravel scatter, then silence

sfx.name: cyclops_sweep_warn
sfx.prompt: a giant grunting as he draws back a huge club, low growling inhale, wood creak

sfx.name: cyclops_sweep
sfx.prompt: a massive wooden club swinging horizontally through the air, huge low whoosh

sfx.name: cyclops_slam_warn
sfx.prompt: a giant heaving a massive club overhead with a long rising strained growl

sfx.name: cyclops_slam
sfx.prompt: a gigantic wooden club slamming into the ground, earth-shaking boom, cracking earth and falling debris

sfx.name: cyclops_stuck
sfx.prompt: a giant straining and grunting while tugging at a club stuck in the ground, frustrated growls, wood creaking

sfx.name: cyclops_pull_free
sfx.prompt: a huge club being wrenched out of cracked earth, rock crumble and a triumphant giant grunt

sfx.name: cyclops_hurt
sfx.prompt: an enormous giant howling in sudden pain, deep monstrous yelp

sfx.name: cyclops_death
sfx.prompt: an enormous giant's dying groan followed by his huge body crashing to the ground with a long rumble

sfx.name: medusa_hiss
sfx.prompt: many snakes hissing together, eerie layered serpent hisses with a soft rattle

sfx.name: medusa_gaze_warn
sfx.prompt: an eerie magical charge building up, rising shimmering hum with whispering hisses

sfx.name: medusa_gaze
sfx.prompt: a powerful petrifying beam firing, sharp magical crack then a sustained piercing hum

sfx.name: medusa_stun
sfx.prompt: a monstrous woman shrieking in pain and surprise, piercing echoing scream with thrashing snakes

sfx.name: medusa_tail_swipe_warn
sfx.prompt: a giant serpent coiling quickly, dry scales scraping on marble and a rattle

sfx.name: medusa_tail_swipe
sfx.prompt: a giant serpent tail whipping through the air and cracking like a huge whip

sfx.name: medusa_hurt
sfx.prompt: a monstrous woman screaming in pain, sharp shriek with angry snake hisses

sfx.name: medusa_death
sfx.prompt: a monstrous woman's long dying wail fading out while her heavy serpent body collapses on marble

sfx.name: hydra_roar
sfx.prompt: a many-headed dragon roaring, several deep reptilian roars overlapping, huge and terrifying

sfx.name: hydra_fire_sweep_warn
sfx.prompt: a huge dragon inhaling deeply without pause, continuous rumbling intake of air that rises steadily in pitch and loudness into a furnace roar, starts immediately

sfx.name: hydra_fire
sfx.prompt: a dragon breathing a continuous stream of fire, roaring flamethrower blast, steady

sfx.name: hydra_head_down
sfx.prompt: a huge dragon head dropping onto rock with a heavy thud, followed by tired panting breaths

sfx.name: hydra_stomp_warn
sfx.prompt: a huge beast lifting a heavy leg with a low threatening growl

sfx.name: hydra_stomp
sfx.prompt: a colossal beast stomping on volcanic rock, massive boom with cracking stone

sfx.name: hydra_bite_warn
sfx.prompt: a giant snake-like dragon head hissing sharply as it draws back to strike

sfx.name: hydra_bite
sfx.prompt: huge dragon jaws snapping shut, a loud sharp crack with a meaty bone crunch, impact at the very start

sfx.name: hydra_hurt
sfx.prompt: a many-headed dragon shrieking in pain, several reptilian screeches overlapping

sfx.name: hydra_death
sfx.prompt: a many-headed dragon's dying roars fading one after another, then a colossal body collapsing on rock

sfx.name: wing_flap
sfx.prompt: one powerful flap of very large feathered wings, deep airy whoosh

sfx.name: neigh
sfx.prompt: a proud horse neighing, clear and heroic

sfx.name: mount
sfx.prompt: a rider swinging onto a horse's back, leather creak, a small snort

sfx.name: land
sfx.prompt: four hooves landing on grass and dirt with a soft heavy thump and wing rustle

sfx.name: wind_loop
sfx.prompt: steady rushing wind while flying fast high in the air, smooth continuous wind noise

sfx.name: sea_loop
sfx.prompt: calm sea waves rolling against a rocky shore, gentle continuous surf with distant gulls

sfx.name: lava_loop
sfx.prompt: bubbling lava and deep volcanic rumble, thick molten bubbles popping, continuous

sfx.name: fire_loop
sfx.prompt: a close bronze brazier fire, dense steady crackling with a soft continuous roar of flames, even level, no pauses

sfx.name: beacon_loop
sfx.prompt: a soft magical pillar of light humming, gentle shimmering choir-like drone, continuous

sfx.name: thunder
sfx.prompt: a crack of thunder inside a dark storm wall, sharp lightning strike then rolling rumble

sfx.name: ui_move
sfx.prompt: a soft short pluck of a lyre string, single note, menu cursor move

sfx.name: ui_accept
sfx.prompt: a short bright plucked lyre chord, three notes rolled quickly upward with a tiny bronze bell ping, clean and dry, starts immediately

sfx.name: ui_back
sfx.prompt: a soft low lyre note falling, menu back

sfx.name: victory
sfx.prompt: a triumphant ancient Greek victory fanfare, short brass horns and lyre flourish with a final drum hit

sfx.name: defeat
sfx.prompt: a dark low horn and a slow drum hit, somber defeat sting

sfx.name: title_card
sfx.prompt: a deep ominous drum hit with a low brass swell, boss introduction sting

sfx.name: trophy
sfx.prompt: a loud sparkling magical chime, quick rising arpeggio of small bright bells with a warm shimmering tail, clearly audible from the start

music.name: music_title
music.prompt: Instrumental ancient Greek heroic main theme for an adventure game: lyre and aulos melody over warm strings and soft hand drums, noble, bright, hopeful, loops smoothly

music.name: music_flight
music.prompt: Instrumental soaring flight theme for riding a winged horse over a sunny sea: sweeping strings, harp arpeggios, light percussion, uplifting and free, ancient Greek colour, loops smoothly

music.name: music_cyclops
music.prompt: Instrumental boss battle music against a giant in a sunlit quarry: pounding war drums, low brass stabs, driving strings, ancient Greek modal melody, heavy and relentless, loops smoothly

music.name: music_medusa
music.prompt: Instrumental boss battle music in a haunted marble sanctuary: eerie female choir pads, tense string ostinato, hissing shakers, sudden percussion hits, sinister and hypnotic, ancient Greek modal melody, loops smoothly

music.name: music_hydra
music.prompt: Instrumental final boss battle music on a volcano against a nine-headed dragon: massive epic orchestra, thunderous taiko drums, roaring brass, fast string runs, choir, apocalyptic and heroic, loops smoothly
